scope: visible reset state plus zero-action probe; not PPO or full solver restoration
limitations: The first reset is a comparison reference, not an assumed clean or stationary state.
Only player angular velocity is exposed; other rigidbody angular velocities and solver state are not certified.
Wait effects are observed at the next zero STEP, not through a live read during idle.
Histories run sequentially; differences are not uniquely attributed to waiting versus prior history.
Stationarity is checked separately, including common motion shared by all agents.
Thresholds are provisional acceptance criteria, not a measured numerical noise floor.
